# WMAR-2 News

> > WMAR-2 News is Baltimore's local news station delivering breaking news, weather forecasts, sports coverage, and traffic updates for Maryland residents.

WMAR-2 News serves the Baltimore metropolitan area and greater Maryland region with comprehensive local news coverage, accurate weather forecasting, real-time traffic information, and sports reporting. The station covers breaking news, crime reports, community events, and regional stories across multiple Maryland counties.

## Core News & Information

- [Local News](https://www.wmar2news.com/news/local-news): WMAR-2 News local news hub covering Baltimore, Maryland breaking news and community stories
- [Local News Hub](https://www.wmar2news.com/local): WMAR-2 local news hub with breaking news, weather, and community stories
- [National News](https://www.wmar2news.com/news/national-news): National news aggregation from AP, Scripps, and other major news sources

## Weather & Traffic

- [Baltimore Weather](https://www.wmar2news.com/weather): WMAR-2 Maryland's Most Accurate Forecast with meteorologists and weather alerts
- [Traffic](https://www.wmar2news.com/traffic): Real-time traffic alerts, road closures, and commute updates for Baltimore area

## Regional Coverage - Central Maryland

- [Baltimore City](https://www.wmar2news.com/news/region/baltimore-city): WMAR-2 Baltimore City news covering crime, community events, and local businesses
- [Baltimore County](https://www.wmar2news.com/news/region/baltimore-county): WMAR-2 Baltimore County news and community coverage for local residents
- [Anne Arundel County](https://www.wmar2news.com/news/region/anne-arundel-county): WMAR-2 News coverage of Anne Arundel County including Annapolis and Glen Burnie
- [Howard County](https://www.wmar2news.com/news/region/howard-county): WMAR-2 Howard County news and regional coverage for Columbia and surrounding areas

## Regional Coverage - Northern & Western Maryland

- [Carroll County](https://www.wmar2news.com/news/region/carroll-county): WMAR-2 Carroll County news covering local communities and public safety
- [Frederick County](https://www.wmar2news.com/news/local-news/frederickcounty): WMAR-2 Frederick County Maryland news hub with crime and community coverage
- [Harford County](https://www.wmar2news.com/news/region/harford-county): WMAR-2 Harford County news covering Bel Air, Havre de Grace, and community stories
